decisions.reason: This flagship distributed ALCMS control solution sits at the core of the firm's established airfield lighting business, so carrying it costs little and its long airport procurement cycles mean its value is still being realized.

The air situation display complements the tower and surveillance portfolio and fits the integrated-operations strategy, and with no evidence that its value has failed, the cheap option is worth keeping.
Training programs are low-cost services that support installed-base customers, so there is little reason to give up this option.
The AGL training course received only modest website presence and could be merged into broader training offers, but it costs little to keep and supports the core lighting business.
The collaboration software is central to the firm's push toward collaborative decision-making, and its value under post-COVID uncertainty remains unresolved, so keeping the option open is justified.
The MLAT surveillance system was launched prominently and fits the strategy, and airport surveillance purchases resolve slowly, so the option is still worth holding.
